messages.subject: Check-in instructions for your Sixth & 14th stay
messages.body:
Hi {{guestFirstName}},
We are looking forward to your arrival on {{arrivalDate}}.

Check-in time: {{checkInTime}}
The apartment is located under the stoop, on your left as you walk in the gate.
Access is via a numeric keypad lock. The code for your stay is set to the last four digits of your phone number.

If anything comes up, reply here or call/text {{housePhone}}.

{{ownerName}}

messages.subject: Check-out reminder for your Sixth & 14th stay
messages.body:
Hi {{guestFirstName}},
A quick reminder that check-out is at {{checkOutTime}} today.

Please leave the place tidy and put trash and recycling in the bins outside. No need to strip beds or gather towels.

Thanks again,
{{ownerName}}

messages.name: Post-stay thank-you
messages.subject: Thank you for staying at Sixth & 14th
messages.body:
Hi {{guestFirstName}},
Thank you again for choosing {{houseName}}. I hope your stay was comfortable and that Brooklyn treated you well.

If there is anything you would like us to know, just reply to this email.

Warmly,
{{ownerName}}
